trigger: a sudoers entry for the iptables tools admits an argument sequence the plugin never builds
classification_rationale: The iptables and ip6tables sudoers entries constrained only the leading arguments
summary: The iptables and ip6tables sudoers entries are replaced by one entry for a root-owned helper (/usr/local/sbin/yuzu-fw-helper) that validates the nine rule shapes the plugin builds and rebuilds the argument list itself. Fixed in 116393fdb. Closure verified at Gate 8 with a hostile-argument suite run under dash, sh and bash. Owner ruling 2026-11-14: fix in this PR.

trigger: the sudoers entry for nft admits any file path as its argument
classification_rationale: The nft sudoers entry took a wildcard argument
summary: The wildcard nft entry is replaced by an `nft load` action in the same helper: it reads the staged rule file once, checks it against the exact grammar the plugin generates, rebuilds the text and gives nft that text on stdin; sudoers keeps only two fixed nft entries (delete and list of the quarantine table). Fixed in f740ce753. Owner ruling 2026-11-15.

trigger: a clock step on the replica while an apply claim is live or orphaned (the same root as CS-S1)
classification_rationale: The apply-claim lifetime was judged on the replica's wall clock
summary: The apply-claim lifetime was judged on the replica's wall clock. Fixed in 116393fdb: one SQL fragment, stamped and compared from the database clock at all four sites; pinned by a [pg] window-edge case and a lexical rule with a pre-fix mutation.

trigger: dispatch_fn throws a type not derived from std::exception
classification_rationale: release_apply_claim was skipped on a non-std throw, leaving the claim live for 120 s
summary: release_apply_claim was skipped on a non-std throw, leaving the claim live for 120 s. Fixed in 116393fdb with a noexcept ScopeExit guard; test throws 42 and fails without the guard.

trigger: a C++ diff with no Resource Ledger
policy_floor: Resource Ledger omission on a C++ diff
classification_rationale: Three stored callbacks and the apply claim were not in the ledger
summary: Three stored callbacks and the apply claim were not in the ledger. Fixed: the ledger fragment now has eight rows (apply claim, owed-list callback, injected steady clock, pause hook, heartbeat sets, unconfirmed cache, helper file, helper nft action).

trigger: apply_fence_token fails during DELETE or a status read
classification_rationale: The failed-token-read branches had no test; a value_or(0) regression would stay green
summary: The failed-token-read branches had no test; a value_or(0) regression would stay green. Fixed in 116393fdb: REST case asserts 202, releasing, fence_unread=1; reconciler case asserts no status is sent and degraded rises.

trigger: the boot call to seed_metrics is deleted
classification_rationale: Nothing pinned the boot-time metric seeding
summary: Nothing pinned the boot-time metric seeding. Fixed: tests/test_quarantine_wiring_lexical.py with self-test mutations, registered in the docs suite.

trigger: --response-retention-days 0 (keep forever) on a server with a contained device
classification_rationale: shorten_ttl cut keep-forever rows to 24 h and the retention pages did not say so
summary: shorten_ttl cut keep-forever rows to 24 h and the retention pages did not say so. Fixed: keep-forever rows are left alone; the retention pages state the 24 h exception for recurring status replies.

trigger: the pool stalls while many cached devices heartbeat
classification_rationale: Degraded drain paths did not count toward the per-pass cap, so one pass could run for N x 2-4 s
summary: Degraded drain paths did not count toward the per-pass cap, so one pass could run for N x 2-4 s. Fixed: a 2 s time budget checked before each device, the rest merged back.

classification_rationale: The tick ran on a pass count rather than elapsed time
summary: The tick ran on a pass count rather than elapsed time. Fixed: tick when 20 s of steady time have passed.

trigger: an agent running as root on an iptables-only host without the installer
classification_rationale: A root agent was sent through the helper that only the installer writes
summary: A root agent was sent through the helper that only the installer writes. Fixed in f740ce753: run the tool directly when euid is 0 (a static decision, not a probe).

classification_rationale: The helper's parent directory was not checked
summary: The helper's parent directory was not checked. Fixed in f740ce753: refuse a non-root owner or other-writable mode, warn on group-writable (Debian ships /usr/local/sbin root:staff 2775); stale temp files removed.

classification_rationale: Out-of-range IPv4 passed the address check and a comment said no name could
summary: Out-of-range IPv4 passed the address check and a comment said no name could. Fixed in f740ce753 in both the C++ and shell twins.

trigger: a force-ended device that never returns (decommissioned)
classification_rationale: An owed release has no operator exit
summary: An owed release has no operator exit. Pre-existing on the PRQ.2 base, so not gated here. Filed as #7785.

classification_rationale: A partial|operation_in_progress reply is recorded as drift
summary: A partial|operation_in_progress reply is recorded as drift. Pre-existing. Filed as #7786.

adjudicated_by: chaos-injector (Gate 5), a different agent from the unhappy-path reporter
adjudication_rationale: The new record is confirmed only by a later status read on the same serialised thread, which reads inactive and re-applies; the unconfirmed gauge counts it.
trigger: an MCP quarantine of a force-ended device while its owed release goes out
classification_rationale: Chaos review ruled the window I8 (self-heals within one tick; nothing claims containment meanwhile)
summary: Chaos review ruled the window I8 (self-heals within one tick; nothing claims containment meanwhile). The self-heal has no test. Filed as #7787.

adjudication_rationale: Owner accepted the residual as a documented one and chose to widen the wording rather than change the design in this PR.
trigger: the staged path the helper opens is replaced between its checks and its open
classification_rationale: The documented residual named the read and a FIFO hang but not that the path is opened with whatever side effects opening it has
summary: The helper opens the staged path the agent names, as root, and its link and file-type checks are not atomic with the open. Nothing read from the file reaches nft. The residual wording is widened to say the path is opened with whatever side effects opening it has. The earlier nft entry had the same property and more.
